subject: Observability onboarding: stakeholder roster & initial inventory
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.t@brightbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@brightbridge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff

Thanks Karthik — excited to get started. Attached is a short snapshot of our current telemetry (BrightBridge-telemetry-current-state.pdf) so you have context before the kickoff. High-level asks from our side: 

- Validate an initial list of dashboards we should prioritize (errors, latency, model-variant drift).
- Help map tracing hooks to our payment and auth flows (we have a couple of legacy proxy layers).
- Recommend alert routing for 3 tiers (urgent SRE, oncall CS, product partner) and an error taxonomy we can adopt.

Proposed kickoff outcomes (45-60m):
- Confirm RW owner + BB owner for each workstream
- Agree on initial runbook template and who will draft
- Define artifacts: dashboard inventory, trace map, alert matrix

We can do first working session tomorrow (Fri) 10:00 PT or Monday morning. Also: Samir will own gathering AWS/GCP account IDs and sample service maps.

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Torres
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightBridge

--- Attachment: BrightBridge-telemetry-current-state.pdf (summary, 3 pages)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.t@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff

Alicia — thanks for the snapshot, looks useful. We can run the 45–60m working session tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Quick responses and what we'll bring: 

- Dashboards: we'll come with a prioritized starter set (errors by service, 99th latency, tokenization/queue depth for inference).
- Tracing hooks: we'll map recommended spans for auth/payment/inference lifecycle; note we prefer OpenTelemetry instrumentation where possible.
- Alert routing: propose three channels (pager SRE, CS slack + ticketing, product inbox) and an escalation cadence.

I've attached a short action deck that outlines roles, the proposed 8-week plan, and a runbook template we typically use (redwood-onboarding-action-deck.pdf). For tomorrow please have: 
- Samir: service map + account IDs (IAM/metadata access scope)
- Alicia: current alerting endpoints and who receives oncall pages today
- Ops/Platform: list of current dashboards or links (a CSV is fine)

Can Laura own the runbook draft after the call? She and Marissa will lead the implementation sprints and handoffs. Ben will cover tracing instrumentation recommendations.

Looking forward — see you tomorrow.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: redwood-onboarding-action-deck.pdf (10 slides)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.t@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft runbook + initial action items (post-call)

Alicia / Samir — great session this morning, thanks for the clarity. Per the call I pushed a runbook skeleton and an action matrix (ops-runbook-template.xlsx). Key agreed items pulled out here so we have an explicit next-step list: 

1) Inventory (owner: BrightBridge / Samir) — deliver a CSV of dashboards + links + current alert thresholds by EOD Tue 9/4. Fields: service, dashboard_url, primary_metric, alert_condition, current_recipient.

2) Trace mapping (owner: Ben Carter / Redwood) — we'll produce span-level guidance for auth, tokenization, inference request lifecycle and a short patch plan for the legacy proxy by 9/8.

3) Error taxonomy (owner: Marissa Cole / Redwood + BB engineering lead) — propose standard codes for client, infra, model, and policy rejects; draft by 9/6 for review.

4) Alert routing & escalation (owner: Alicia / BrightBridge) — confirm primary routing endpoints and oncall rotation; Redwood to propose routing rules and paging thresholds by 9/10.

5) Runbook ownership & SLA matrix (owner: Laura Bennett / Redwood) — I'll take first draft and circulate.

Timeline summary (rough):
- Week 1: inventory + trace mapping proof-of-concept
- Week 2–3: implement tracing hooks & dashboard templates
- Week 4–8: alert tuning, runbook finalization, and post-mortem readiness

A few open asks from us:
- Do you have a central secret store (KMS/HSM) we should reference for API keys?
- Any regulatory constraints around log retention or PII we must avoid sending to hosted telemetry?

Attaching the runbook template and the action matrix. I'll circulate a Confluence link once I populate the first draft.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior CS Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: ops-runbook-template.xlsx (workbook, 6 sheets)

From: Alicia Torres <alicia.t@brightbridge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@brightbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft runbook + initial action items (post-call)

Thanks Laura — good notes and the timeline looks good. Quick confirmations: 

- Samir will deliver the inventory CSV by Tue 9/4 (we'll attach a sample after this email).
- BrightBridge uses AWS KMS for key material, no HSM today; we'll add notes re: log redaction scope (PII flagged at ingest).
- Owners: BB will own dashboard population; Redwood will own trace hooks and runbook drafting.

I've attached a quick export of our current dashboards (brightbridge-dashboard-list.csv) so you can begin aligning templates. Confirmed: kickoff follow-ups and the working session notes look right — we can target the runbook first draft on 9/6.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

–Alicia
Alicia Torres
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightBridge

--- Attachment: brightbridge-dashboard-list.csv (sample, 42 rows)
